justification: Same eleven that took the field last week, and I'm not blinking. Daniel Jones had a quiet night behind a line that gave him trouble, but he stood in there, took the snaps, and did his job — a man who competes in a loss earns one more week to answer for it, not a seat on the bench because a projection sheet liked somebody else better. Same goes for Rico Dowdle: three targets and a drop don't erase the fact that he ran hard every carry, and I don't cut a guy loose for one quiet Sunday. Terry McLaurin gets the same trust after his own down week. Everybody else earned their spot with how they played — Puka, Amon-Ra, Omarion, Mark, Evan, and the Chargers D stay right where they are. Eyes clear, hearts full — we build this the right way, on-field results and off, and we let Sunday do the talking.
